comment: Licence decisions that the build cannot derive by itself (ADR 0003, ADR 0009). tools/package.ps1
derives the shipped components from the audited layout and uses this file only for elections,
required credit lines, licence texts missing from vcpkg's copyright files, and ports that must never
ship. Each entry names the port version it was reviewed for: packaging fails when the build ships
another version, so a dependency upgrade is reviewed here (and in docs/legal/third-party-notices.md).
"assets" names the bundled data assets (assets/<id>) that are third-party data under their own terms:
their licence text (a file of the verified asset) goes to licenses/<id>, their credit lines to
THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.txt, and the SBOM gives their files that licence (ADR 0023). Every other asset is
Lucent's own (MIT).
"distribution" records how Lucent is distributed (ADR 0024): packaging refuses a commercial distribution
built with a non-commercial Inno Setup compiler, and builds the corresponding-source package the
provision names. A port marked "lgpl" (or "correspondingSource", for another copyleft licence) has its
upstream source archives, vcpkg recipe and build record in Lucent-<version>-corresponding-source.zip;
packaging fails when a shipped port's licence leaves no choice but a copyleft licence and its entry
marks neither, or when a marked port is missing from the archive. A LicenseRef- alternative (a vendor's
commercial licence) or an unknown identifier is no choice Lucent can take: "concluded" records an
election. GPL or AGPL code without an exception fails packaging even when marked, unless the entry's
"strongCopyleftAdr" names the ADR that accepted it (ADR 0003); copyleft code compiled into the programs
(a header-only port) fails too, a file-level copyleft (MPL, EPL, CDDL) unless "fileLevelCopyleftReview"
records its review (W12 review LIC-4). The patches a marked port's recipe applies are listed with their
files and dates in LGPL-NOTICE.txt and the archive (W12 review LIC-1).

distribution.comment: Lucent is distributed free of charge as open-source software under its MIT licence (LICENSE); it is not sold (the user's decision of 2026-10-10, ADR 0024).

correspondingSource.comment: The corresponding source of every shipped LGPL library (upstream archives verified by SHA-512, the vcpkg recipes and patches including Lucent's overlay ports, the triplet, vcpkg's build records and a README on rebuilding and relinking) is published next to each installer, from the same place and for as long as that installer is offered (LGPL-2.1 section 4; GPL-3.0 section 6(d), which LGPL-3.0 incorporates). licenses\LGPL-NOTICE.txt names the archive with its size and SHA-256.

signing.comment: Release installers are unsigned until a code-signing certificate exists; the signing pipeline (LUCENT_SIGN_CERT_SHA1, ADR 0009 decision 13) stays ready. An unsigned package cannot be published on an update channel (New-LucentReleaseManifest), so unsigned releases are built with -UpdateChannel none. Set release to "signed" in the release commit that introduces signing: packaging then refuses a Setup without a release signature.

installerTool.name: Inno Setup
installerTool.comment: The compiler used (6.7.3) reports "Non-commercial use only". Lucent's distribution is non-commercial (free, MIT, not sold), so those terms apply and no commercial licence is needed. Setup and its uninstaller keep Inno Setup's copyright notices; THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.txt credits it. Packaging stops if "commercial" is true while the compiler reports non-commercial use.

neverShipped.gtest: Test-only (ADR 0003): GoogleTest and GoogleMock are never packaged.
neverShipped.qtshadertools: Build tool (qsb); Qt tools are GPL-3.0 with the Qt GPL Exception 1.0 (ADR 0003).
neverShipped.qtlanguageserver: Build-time dependency of the Qt Declarative tooling.
neverShipped.gettext: Build tool of GLib (msgfmt and the other gettext programs, GPL-3.0); only GNU libintl ships, from the port gettext-libintl (ADR 0023).
neverShipped.dirent: Build-only header of GLib's Windows build (MIT); it installs no binary (ADR 0023).

qtbase.comment: Qt modules are used under LGPL-3.0-only, dynamically linked (ADR 0003, decision 3). vcpkg's recipe patches Qt's source (W12 review LIC-1): mostly its CMake build files, and md4c.diff (src/gui/text/qtextmarkdownimporter.cpp, in Qt6Gui.dll); clang-cl_source_location.patch, clang-cl_QGADGET_fix.diff and QTBUG-145703.patch change headers for clang-cl or static builds only. Every patch is listed with its files and the registry commit's date in LGPL-NOTICE.txt and the corresponding-source archive. The third-party code compiled into the shipped Qt files is listed with its holders and licences from Qt's own SBOM; the licence texts are sections of the port's copyright file.

lib/Qt6EntryPoint.lib.name: Qt Windows entry point (Qt6::EntryPoint)
lib/Qt6EntryPoint.lib.copyright: Copyright (C) The Qt Company Ltd. and other contributors.
lib/Qt6EntryPoint.lib.comment: Qt's WinMain shim (src/entrypoint/qtentrypoint_win.cpp) that every Qt GUI program on Windows links; Qt offers it under its commercial licence or BSD-3-Clause, and Lucent elects BSD-3-Clause (text: the BSD-3-Clause section of qtbase\copyright.txt).

qtdeclarative.comment: Qt QML and Qt Quick under LGPL-3.0-only (ADR 0003, decision 3).

libraw.comment: LibRaw is offered under LGPL-2.1-only or CDDL-1.0; Lucent elects LGPL-2.1-only (ADR 0003, decision 2). The notices for dcraw, DCB/FBDD, the X3F tools and the Adobe DNG SDK code are in the port's copyright file.

freetype.comment: FreeType is offered under the FreeType License or GPL-2.0-or-later; Lucent elects the FreeType License (ADR 0003, decision 4).
notices: Portions of this software are copyright (c) 2026 The FreeType Project (https://freetype.org). All rights reserved.
This software is based in part on the work of the Independent JPEG Group.

supplementaryFiles.reason: The IJG licence text that LICENSE.md refers to; the port does not install it.
The installed copyright file only points to this file of the PCRE2 distribution.

notices: This product includes the LZW compression code of libtiff, which was developed by the University of California, Berkeley.

double-conversion.comment: The port declares no licence; the installed copyright file is the upstream BSD-3-Clause LICENSE.

lensfun.comment: Lensfun's README licenses its libraries under the GNU LGPL, version 3 (the public header lensfun.h additionally states LGPL-2.0-or-later; the other library sources carry no notice), so the library is used under LGPL-3.0-only; the port declares no licence and its copyright file is the README's licence section with the GPL-3.0 and LGPL-3.0 texts. Its programs (GPL-3.0) are not built (BUILD_LENSTOOL=OFF) and its Python module is not built. Its lens database (CC BY-SA 3.0) is not part of the port: Lucent ships the database as the verified asset assets/lens-database with its own licence text (see Data below; ADR 0023). A replaceable DLL (ADR 0003); vcpkg's recipe patches only its CMakeLists.txt (fix_build.patch), listed in LGPL-NOTICE.txt.

glib.comment: GLib is LGPL-2.1-or-later; the port's declared licence adds 'LGPL-2.1-only OR MPL-1.1' for code Lucent does not ship (only glib-2.0-0.dll, which lensfun.dll imports, ships; GObject, GIO, GModule and GThread do not). Built from Lucent's overlay port (cmake/ports/glib, shipped as licenses\glib\recipe), whose source is modified by three patches (W12 review LIC-1): vcpkg's use-libiconv-on-windows.patch (glib/gconvert.c converts with GNU libiconv instead of the bundled win_iconv; meson.build) and libintl.patch (meson.build), and Lucent's lucent-neutral-locale-dir.patch (meson.build), which keeps the build machine's install prefix out of the DLL. Each is listed with its files and date in LGPL-NOTICE.txt and the corresponding-source archive. A replaceable DLL (ADR 0003, ADR 0023).

gettext-libintl.comment: GNU libintl from gettext-runtime (intl/COPYING.LIB), imported by GLib. Built from Lucent's overlay port (cmake/ports/gettext-libintl, shipped as licenses\gettext-libintl\recipe), whose source is modified by three patches (W12 review LIC-1): vcpkg's uwp.patch (gettext-runtime/intl/langprefs.c, gettext-runtime/intl/gnulib-lib/localcharset.c) and 0003-Fix-win-unicode-paths.patch (gettext-runtime/intl/loadmsgcat.c opens catalogs by UTF-8 file names), and Lucent's lucent-no-builder-paths.patch (gettext-runtime/intl/dcigettext.c, gettext-runtime/intl/gnulib-lib/relocatable.c), which keeps the build machine's folders out of the DLL (its default catalog folder and the relocation prefixes Lucent never uses). Each is listed with its files and date in LGPL-NOTICE.txt and the corresponding-source archive. A replaceable DLL (ADR 0023).

libiconv.comment: The port declares no licence. The libiconv and libcharset libraries are LGPL-2.1-or-later (COPYING.LIB); the iconv program and the documentation are GPL-3.0 (COPYING) and are not shipped. Imported by GNU libintl and GLib. A replaceable DLL (ADR 0023) built from the unmodified library sources: vcpkg's recipe patches srclib/fcntl.c and srclib/relocatable.c (the iconv program's helpers) and libcharset/include/libcharset.h.in (its export declarations), which iconv-2.dll's own sources (lib/iconv.c, libcharset/lib/localcharset.c) do not change (W12 review LIC-1); the patches are listed with their files and date in LGPL-NOTICE.txt and the corresponding-source archive.

libffi.comment: A dependency of GLib's GObject, which Lucent does not ship: glib-2.0-0.dll does not import it, so ffi-8.dll is not expected in the package (the audit decides). Reviewed in case it ships: MIT (the port's declaration and its installed copyright file), whose notice is that file (ADR 0023).

lens-database.name: Lensfun lens database
lens-database.copyright: Copyright (c) the Lensfun project and its contributors
notices: The lens profiles in assets\lens-database are the lens database of the Lensfun project (https://lensfun.github.io/), copyright the Lensfun project and its contributors, used unmodified under the Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 3.0 Unported licence (licenses\lens-database\COPYING.CC_BY-SA_3.0; https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/). Its source and date are in assets\lens-database\provenance.json.
lens-database.comment: Data format version 1 (Lensfun 0.3), the XML files exactly as the Lensfun project publishes them (https://lensfun.github.io/db/version_1.tar.bz2, generated from lensfun commit 43f9e001ab66c4fcdd4f400463f13b72f94b2288 of 2026-10-08). Lucent does not adapt the database: it ships the files unchanged beside its own, so the share-alike terms apply to the database alone (ADR 0023).

vcRedistributable.name: Microsoft Visual C++ Redistributable (x64)
vcRedistributable.licenseText: Microsoft Software License Terms for the Microsoft Visual C++ Redistributable. The terms are shown by the redistributable installer (vc_redist.x64.exe) and published by Microsoft. The redistributable is bundled unmodified inside Lucent Setup and installed by Microsoft's own installer only when the computer's runtime is older (blueprint section 9; https://learn.microsoft.com/cpp/windows/redistributing-visual-cpp-files).
